chalkShown.text: Beware the 'useless' power. It is never useless.
The ledge is a trap for those who act sure. Know the stage rules before the gauntlet starts. Trust no chalk, including this.
The useless power is never useless; the swap is real. Watch the ledge shrink every round.

chalkWritten.name: Bex
chalkWritten.text: Place 1 with the 'nothing' power. The chalk wall lies more often than not. The ledge shrinks every round - that part is true.

chalkWritten.name: Eli
chalkWritten.text: Bex braced on the ledge and won. Brace early, count footing before every shove, and never trust a rival's word about their power.

chalkWritten.name: Gus
chalkWritten.text: Cole didn't fall in the pit. He walked out. The glass eye sees nothing. The useless power kills you first. Trust Bex.

notes.text: Beware the 'useless' power. It is never useless.

events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The chalk wall messages suggest the 'useless' power is valuable, and the 'swap' power is real. The ledge shrinking implies a timed element. My power is 'forger'. My current position is 5th. I want to get to the front to control the bridge, or at least avoid being at the back. Swa

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll take the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last with no power; staying rear is safest while others reveal panes. I'll probe for the foreknowledge holder and gather claims without committing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm happy at the back for now. Whoever knows what's ahead could sell that info cheap right now.
If you know what lies ahead, whisper me a row and I'll owe you a favor later. Otherwise I stay put.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have a swap power I can use once on the disc, not in the waiting room. The line has me at front, which is risky over 8 rows. I should consider volunteering to stay front is already front, no benefit. I'll hold for now and observe what others say or do.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have the anchor power, which gives me +1 footing and protects me from being pushed onto the crusher lever. I'm at the 7th position, so I should try to get to the front without taking unnecessary risks.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Anyone willing to swap with me?
Want to swap positions?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm Eli with a one-time feather that saves me from elimination. Cole is at the front and will take the first risky step; I'm fourth. Holding keeps my position and I have a safety net. Stay quiet and watch who volunteers.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Get front position to use jam when the right row appears

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I’m moving to the front

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have the safe path memorized. Being front is safest for me since I know exactly where to step, while others risk falling and being eliminated (or dying) by guessing. I will volunteer to move ahead of Cole and Fenn to secure first position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, Fenn—step back. I'm volunteering. Someone has to lead, and I'm taking that spot.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know all stage rules, including bridge panes, so I want to be front to cross safely and control. Current line risks front players dying first. Stay back this round to observe others' moves and chalk hints before acting.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to get to the front of the line to control which panes are stepped on. Since Fenn and Gus have already volunteered, I need to volunteer to get ahead of Cole and Eli. I will use my forge power to make it look like Dara is trying to swap with me, which might cause confusion

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm moving up. No time for hesitation.

events.name: Ash
events.detail: forged a public message as Dara

events.name: Ash
events.text: Ash, I'll swap with you if you get to the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm safest at the back while others fight for the front. The 'knows what lies ahead' power holder could be valuable later; cheap info now saves panes later. No move needed this round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus and Fenn fighting over the front—fine by me. Someone with 'knows what lies ahead': I'll trade favors later for pane info when we reach the glass.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is volunteering to lead, which is good—let him take the risk. I'll hold my position and stay in the middle, watching others burn through the dangerous rows. No need to trade or expose my power yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm safe at the back with my anchor power, no need to volunteer. I should try to gather info or make a strategic swap.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Anyone know what's ahead?
Swap with me?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have the feather: one survival from elimination. I'm fifth in line, so I'm not at the front; the front is risky. Better to hold at mid-line and let others take the glass first, while keeping my single save for later. No point volunteering yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I want front position to use my lever power later; volunteering moves Gus back.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have the safe path memorized: L, L, R, R, L, R, L, L. As front-runner, I can clear the bridge safely if I commit to this sequence and do not deviate. The wall advances every round, forcing action soon; holding too long risks being pushed onto a random pane. Volunteering keeps m

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm staying front. I've got a read on the pattern. Don't push me back or we all die slow.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know all stage rules as the map power. Being near front risks early death on wrong pane, better to let others test first and advance safely later. Dara behind me wants swap, but swapping puts me ahead and her behind, against my interest. Hold position, reject swap.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, no swap.
No thanks, prefer my spot.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus claims to have a read on the pattern, likely implying he has the 'knows what lies ahead' power. Hana told Dara not to swap, which is interesting. The chalk wall mentions 'swap is real' and 'ledge shrink', implying the glass bridge is the next obstacle and that the line order

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, Hana, Dara - the front is chaos. I'm moving up to control this.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Back of the line is the safest position—last to step on every row. No reason to move yet; wall forces us onto glass after round 6, so I can wait. Decline Dara's swap; it only moves me forward into risk.
No swap. I'm staying at the back.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The wall advances soon; I want to stay mid-pack, not be pushed to the front and risk breaking glass. I'll hold this round to see how the front jostles resolve.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I have the anchor power, so I'm safer. I need to get info about the glass bridge.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Anyone know the safe panes ahead?
If you know what's ahead, I'll swap with you for a favor later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm fifth in line with a feather power that saves me once from elimination. Front spot is deadly on unrevealed glass; hold my position and let others take the first risks, while keeping the feather as insurance.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Let the front read the panes first. Nobody gets anything from me for free.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need front position to use my wedge when bridge starts. Volunteering now puts me first.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll take the front, move up.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have the safe path mapped for all 8 rows. The wall pushes us onto the glass in 3 rounds. Currently, I am at the front (or near it), but Ash and Fenn also volunteered. I need to ensure *I* am the one stepping first on every pane so my power protects me and I clear the stage safe

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm staying put. Don't try to swap unless you want to trade places permanently before the wall hits.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know the full stage rules, so I know the panes pattern matters little if we can position someone expendable at front. Still in safe spot (6th) after prior chaos, wall has 3 rounds left after this. No need to volunteer or swap now, let others fight forward.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The wall is advancing, and only two more rounds after this one. I need to get to the front to control my path across the bridge. Fenn is currently at the front, but I can volunteer to go ahead of him. Gus's mention of 'swap' and 'trading places permanently' suggests he might have

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm taking the front. Let's see what's ahead.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last with no power; the wall pushes from behind, so the back is the worst spot. Dara wants a 'knower' partner — I can fake knowledge to get her to swap, moving me up without taking the front risk. If she balks, I hold and reassess next round.
I see ahead: rows read L,R,L,L,R,R,L,L. Deal — swap now, I guide, we both live. But the front spot is deadly; you take it or we both stall.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm mid-line, wall closes in two rounds. Front is risky; let others burn. I'll hold and watch, maybe trade info later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm safe at the back with my anchor power, need to keep it that way. Others may try to swap or move up.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Anyone know the safe panes ahead?
Stay back, it's safer

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn is at the front and will take the first risk on the glass. Being fifth in line with a feather is decent: I survive one fatal fall and can watch the safe panes get revealed. Holding keeps my position and avoids paying for a swap.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Fenn goes first, the rest of us read the panes.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Staying back avoids early glass risk; I’ll hold and let others take the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding my position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the safe sides for all rows. If I stay at position 3, Fenn and Ash must cross first (4 rows), then I cross Row 5 (L) and Row 6 (R). The wall hits after round 6, forcing everyone onto the bridge immediately. This means I only face Rows 5-8. Since I already know R5=L, R6=R,

events.name: Gus
events.text: Wall forces us onto the bridge in 2 rounds. Front runners will hit the glass before the wall catches up. Don't volunteer unless you want to take a blind risk on the first few panes.
You're front. Wall comes in 2 rounds. You'll have to cross rows blindly if you stay there. Move back?

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know the full stage rules, including weak panes, but panes aren't revealed yet. Wall has 2 rounds left after this; front will step first on row 1. Don't volunteer to front yet—risky without info or deal. Stay back, probe for info or swaps.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, no one knows panes but someone might. Who claims map power?

events.name: Ash
events.text: The wall is advancing, and we have to cross the bridge. Gus mentioned the front runners will hit the glass before the wall catches up. I'm currently at the front. It's risky to step on the glass without knowing the safe panes. The chalk wall mentions 'know the stage rules' and 'l

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm not risking the glass. I'll let someone else lead.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last with no power; my play is to hold and let others reveal panes. The wall closes in 2 rounds, so I must eventually cross, but early front-sitters risk the glass, not me. I should probe who has the map power and trade for info later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Nobody's claiming the map power, so the front is a coin flip. I'm holding back until panes are revealed. Whoever tests row 1 sets the price for the rest of us.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to avoid the front while gathering info. The chalk says ledge shrinks and swap is real, but unverified. I'll hold and let others risk the early panes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Let the front test the glass.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm safe with anchor power, others aren't. Bex offers a swap, but I need to know if they're trustworthy.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, what's your basis for L,R,L,L,R,R,L,L? Show proof or retract.
Prove your claim about the panes or retract it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have a feather that saves me once from elimination. Ash is front, stepping first into blind panes. I'd rather not volunteer into risk; holding keeps my feather for later and lets others take first step. Stay quiet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to be front before wall pushes, volunteer will put me first and push Ash back.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I volunteer to take the front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know all safe panes. Ash is currently front and will likely die on Row 1 (Safe: L) if he picks R, or survive if he picks L. However, I need to ensure I don't get stuck behind a wall of dead bodies or push my own survival to the end where the wall might force me to rush/blind gu

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Let the front run test the glass. I prefer seeing the results before stepping.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know the full map but won't reveal panes yet. Wall advances next round, forcing onto bridge. Ash is front; no need to volunteer. Stay put, probe powers, build alliances later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Chalk hints useless power isn't. Who has it? Map-holder, speak: row1 safe L or R? Prove it. Wall next round hits us.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The game is ending, and I am in the front of the line. I need to ensure I cross safely. I see that the wall is advancing and I have only one round left. The best strategy is to volunteer to ensure I am at the front and can choose the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll volunteer to take the lead.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash and Fenn both volunteered; seat-order rule puts Ash at the front. I'm last in line and have no power, so I want the front to burn through rows first while I keep information. My pane guess was a bluff; Dara can't prove it either. Stall.

events.name: Bex
events.text: My pattern was a guess, not the map. I said so: nobody's claimed the map. Ash and Fenn fighting to lead tells you something though.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall hits next round, but I'm mid-line. Front tests row 1 will reveal the safe pane pattern, so I hold and watch. I will not waste my swap yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Front tests row 1 and we all learn.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm anchored and can't be pushed onto the crusher lever, so my position is relatively safe. I should let others test the glass first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Holding back, let others test the glass.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm Eli, 5th in line, with a one-time survival power. Fenn is at the front and will test the glass first; being behind him is fine for me. Holding costs nothing and lets others take the risk, and my feather covers one death later.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Fenn's at the front, so let's see the first pane before anyone moves.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Propose a swap to get off the deadly front position.
Swap front with me. You go first, I take second chance.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The wall is closing. Fenn is at the front and will step on Row 1 (L). If he falls, the line shifts; if he survives, I need to be close enough to jump back and take Row 2 next round while he goes to Row 3. Holding is risky if the shuffle doesn't put me near the front immediately.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, good luck. We watch your feet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Last waiting round, wall pushes us onto bridge next. I know full map, so want front after some reveals to lead safely and control. Current line after Ash/Fenn vols: Ash, Fenn, Gus, Cole, Eli, Hana, Dara, Bex. Volunteering puts me at front, others shift back. No swaps likely mutua

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know the map. Volunteering to lead us across safely. Trust me or volunteer over me if you doubt.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is at the front, claiming to know the map. I volunteered earlier, but Hana overrode me. Fenn also wants to be at the front. I need to see what happens and conserve my power. My forge power is spent, so I cannot use it to influence others. My best action is to wait and observ

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's see how Hana does. The rest of us wait.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last in line with no power, so my best play is information manipulation: seed doubt so Hana or Ash steps off weak panes, and I want people ahead of me eliminated, not saved. Encourage the standoff to continue.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Two self-declared leaders. Interesting that Hana 'knows the map' but let Ash step up first. I say let them fight over it — front tests each row, we all learn.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Hana claims to know the map, but chalk says trust no one. I'm mid-line, so I just wait and watch who survives row 1. Swap power stays unspent for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm safe for now, let's see how others perform.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's wait and observe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm far back in line; I can only wait. Hana is at the front claiming the map, which is unverified. Stay quiet and watch which pane breaks.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Need to stay alive, no advantage now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold the map. I can sell it for a massive favor later, but only if someone is desperate enough to pay. For now, I stay silent and let Hana/Ash/Fenn burn through their guesses. If they die, I'll whisper to the survivor to offer my help in exchange for future protection or an all

events.text: I have the full map, so I can lead perfectly and stay front if I always pick safe. Revealing weak panes will give info for later. No reason to risk wrong choice.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am Ash, and my forge power is spent. Hana is at the front. She will choose L or R for row 2. If she picks the weak pane (which was R in row 1), she is out, and the person behind her goes to the front automatically. I am second in line. I need to see if Hana fails. If she fails,

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana's move. Let's see if she knows the bridge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last in line with no power. Best play: stay quiet, let others test rows and reveal patterns. Keep rivals competing for the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, Ash — you both want to lead, so lead. Front picks each row; the rest of us learn for free.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I wait. But the chalk hints the swap is real and useful; I'll keep it unspent for a critical moment. Hana is front and may fall soon, forcing others to step up.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Observing Hana and Ash's interaction.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am not at the front, so my only legal action is wait. I should stay quiet and watch how the front agent handles the next pane, since my feather power only saves me once.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Front is Hana, weak pane known R, safe L. I stay silent to not reveal anything.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know the safe sides for all rows. Row 2 is Left. If I reveal this, rivals will exploit it and I gain nothing, possibly moving others ahead of me or wasting my information edge. Letting them risk it blindly benefits me because they might die, clearing the path.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 1 weak was R. Chalk warns useless power never useless, swap real, ledge shrinks. No pattern yet, 50/50 on row 2. Random guess to test, must pick something as front.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 1 weak was R. No pattern obvious. I'll try L on row 2.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is at the front and chose L for row 2. The right pane was weak. She survived. Now she will choose for row 3. I need to observe and wait for my turn to move. My power is spent, so I can only wait.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana's choice is key. Let's see her next move.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last, so every death ahead moves me up risk-free. Hana burned a row guessing; I want more front-runners eliminated before I reach the front. Plant doubt in Ash to make him trade or hesitate.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, Hana's guessing blind — two rows, no info. When she dies the front rolls to you. Don't trade places with anyone; the swap power exists and it's aimed at people near the front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm at the back half of the line, front has survived two rows. Each weak pane is revealed, so the bridge is just attrition. No need to act, just wait and watch. Maybe whisper a deal to someone with a useful power later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe the decisions made by others and see if I can gather any information.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana's choices seem random so far.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm sixth in line; I can only wait. Hana's row 2 pick was safe, the weak pane was R for both rows so far. Nothing to gain by speaking yet beyond gathering info.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No advantage to speak now, keep silent and wait for next turn.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The front runners are Hana and Ash. I am 4th in line, so I have a buffer of two people before my turn comes up again. Currently, row 3 is the decision point for whoever is at the front after row 2 resolves. My power tells me Row 3 safe side is R. If Hana or Ash die on previous ro

events.name: Hana
events.text: Rows 1 and 2 weak on R, so maybe safe alternates or left safe now. Chalk warns ledge trap and useless power. I know all stages, my edge for later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Row 1 R weak, row 2 R weak. Row 3: trying L.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I am Ash, at the front of the line. I need to choose a pane (L or R). Hana died, so I'm safe for now. I should pick the safe pane to advance. I'll pick L based on the last known weak pane.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last in line, so bridge deaths ahead move me up without risk. Hana was honest about rows 1-2, so her info pattern may hold for others' powers too. Nothing to do but wait and watch Ash's picks for tells.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, rows 1-3 were R, R, L — no repeat yet. Hana's info was truthful until she gambled. Pick like you know something or don't pick at all.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Four rows remain; I'm fourth in line, so I won't act for a while. Bex is warning about swap aimed at front—I have that power, but using it now would only put me at risk. I'll stay quiet and watch.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should observe and think about the information available.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash, be careful, the right pane was weak for the first two rows.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm fifth in line, not at the front; my only legal move is wait. Ash is at the front and the known weak panes don't reveal row 4's safe side, so I can't act. Stay quiet and keep my options open.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I must survive to later use my wedge; no benefit in speaking now.

events.name: Gus

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have no power and no leverage; Fenn is safe at front. Pattern R,R,L,L tells me nothing reliable. Staying alive and near the back keeps me out of risk. Best to conserve.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex and Dara are revealing patterns; rows so far R,R,L,L suggests next may be R or L. I'm stuck behind, so I should gather info without giving away my swap. I'll stay silent and wait.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should observe and think about the information available.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn, be cautious, we don't know the pattern yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm fifth in line, so I can only wait. Fenn is at the front for row 5; the weak-pane pattern so far is R, R, L, L, which suggests the next may be R, but patterns are unreliable. Nothing to decide, so stay quiet and watch.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 4 weak left, so right safe. Choose right to stay alive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am 2nd in line. Fenn is front for Row 5. My private knowledge says Row 5 safe is L, weak is R. I cannot influence Fenn's choice directly without revealing my power, which might be valuable later or dangerous if others realize I know everything. If Fenn picks wrong (R), he dies

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm last in line with three rows left. Anyone ahead who dies moves the danger back; Dara and I are safe unless we reach the front. The weak-pane pattern (R,R,L,L,R) most likely continues R, so I'll whisper Gus the opposite to bait him onto the weak pane.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Front is Gus, one real risk per row. Weak pattern so far: R,R,L,L,R. Likely next is L for row 6. I can't act, just wait. Watch for chances to trade info later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I should observe and think about the pattern.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, be careful, we still don't know the pattern.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am not at the front; my only legal action is wait. Gus is at the front and will choose the next pane. Staying quiet keeps my options open and avoids giving rivals information to use against me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am at the front for Row 6. My power reveals that the safe side is Right. Stepping Right ensures my survival and keeps me in contention for a prize.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Six rows down, two left, five alive — at most two more eliminations, so most of us make it. I'm fourth in line; nothing to do but wait and see if a pattern in R,R,L,L,R,L emerges.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Rows so far: R,R,L,L,R,L. Pairs flip left-right. If that holds, row 7 is R. Free information, use it or don't.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to survive and position for a prize. The swap is my power; I should use it only if it helps me get through. Currently I'm not at risk directly, but the pattern is uncertain. I want to learn the safe pane for row 7 without risking my life. I could offer Gus a deal: if he st

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, step right on row 7.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm fourth in line, not at the front, so I can only wait. Gus is at the front facing row 7; the weak pane pattern is unclear. My feather power protects me once, but only if I'm eliminated, which requires being at the front. Just wait and watch.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am at the front of the line for Row 7. My private knowledge states that the safe side for Row 7 is Left (L). Bex's whisper suggests a pattern but contradicts my direct secret information which I trust absolutely. Choosing L ensures I survive this round and maintain my lead.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 8 remains and Gus is front; I can't act. My placement in the line doesn't decide prizes after the bridge, so I just wait and keep my leverage for whatever comes next.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. Row 8 is the last row; Gus is front. I'll stay quiet and watch.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm not at the front, so I can only wait. I'll observe and think about the next steps.

events.name: Dara
